prompt:
Create a high-fidelity portrait mobile web app screen at 390×844 for「台灣停車預測」. This is the familiar category-standard parking search interface for someone driving to「新莊體育館」. Show a complete usable screen: top destination search and location control, large map with street labels and individually tappable roadside parking-space markers, a distinct off-street parking-lot marker, a selected space information card, nearby results sheet with several comparison rows, and simple bottom navigation. No browser or device frame.
The selected roadside space is「正中路 25 號」. Keep these fields separate and readable:「目前觀測：有位」「距離 180 公尺」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」. Also show one occupied space and one status-unknown space with text and distinct symbols, not color alone. Show synthetic-data disclosure「合成示意資料，非即時資訊」. Do not attribute data to a city department or imply actual availability.
Use a calm conventional map product visual language: crisp neutral white and light-gray surfaces, charcoal text, restrained blue action accents, green/red/gray spot states, comfortable touch targets, clear spacing. The map drives the screen; the selected details and results support it. Keep status, data quality, source timing and prediction visually distinct. No invented route, ETA, probability or benefit claim. No illustration style or novelty motif; render a polished, accessible, familiar map app.
